# manual capture: assert message + stack, for the repro, the control and one variant
# compiler: main-debug  (<repo>\build\Debug\bin\dxc.exe)
# version:  dxcompiler.dll: 1.10(5433-ab540090)(1.9.0.5433) - 1.9.0.5433 (triage, ab5400907)
# harness:  assert-stack.cmd   (cdb 10.0.26100.6584, x64)  -- re-runnable
# ran:      2026-08-06T22:00:43.1756154-07:00
# why:      dxc sends DXASSERT text to OutputDebugString and then __debugbreak()s, so a plain
#           run shows only 'Internal compiler error: Terminal Error 0x80000003' on stderr with
#           no message, file or line -- and the line number is the whole finding here. See
#           include/dxc/Support/Global.h (DXASSERT).
# NOTE:     hand-driven capture, not a probe. Not scored by match.json.
#           Stacks trimmed to the frames that matter; module-load and symbol-path noise removed.
#
# CASE 1  repro.hlsl, with the exact arguments in cmd.txt. The assert is
#         DXASSERT(0, "not implemented yet") at lib/HLSL/HLOperationLower.cpp:8801, in
#         TranslateCBAddressUserLegacy -- the function named in the issue title. Note the line:
#         the issue reports 6207, which in Nov 2020 was the CallInst arm's final lse. PR
#         #3034 (eaa7f95d0, 2020-11-17) inserted an IntrinsicInst branch for lifetime markers,
#         so llvm.memcpy -- an IntrinsicInst -- now lands in that branch's inner lse at 8801
#         instead of the outer one at 8804. Same missing HLOpcodeGroup::NotHL case.
#         The frames show the calling context: TranslateHLSubscript (CBufferSubscript) ->
#         TranslateCBOperationsLegacy -> TranslateCBAddressUserLegacy -> TranslateCBGepLegacy ->
#         TranslateCBAddressUserLegacy (bitcast arm) -> TranslateCBAddressUserLegacy (the trap),
#         inside DxilGenerationPass::GenerateDxilOperations.
# CASE 2  control-fieldwise-payload.hlsl -- the same struct copied field by field. No trap: the
#         only break is the loader's initial one and the stack after 'g' shows the process
#         exiting normally. See variant-control-fieldwise-payload-main-debug.txt for exit 0.
# CASE 3  variant-local-payload.hlsl -- payload filled from a local instead of the cbuffer.
#         It also traps, but at a DIFFERENT assert in a DIFFERENT and EARLIER pass:
#         !(onlyUsedByLifetimeMarkers(BCI)) at lib/Transforms/Scalar/ScalarReplAggregatesHLSL.cpp
#         :2630 in SROA_Helper::RewriteBitCast, under SROA_Parameter_HLSL::runOnModule -- it
#         never reaches DxilGenerationPass. So it is NOT a control for this predicate; it is a
#         separate observation, recorded because it is why the obvious negative control had to
#         be replaced by CASE 2.
